_comment: Rebrand values. Anything left as null is SKIPPED by scripts/rebrand.mjs rather than guessed at — a wrong phone number or address across every page is worse than an unchanged one.

phone._note: Matched bare, so it also fixes '+91 9810504039' and the WhatsApp deep link wa.me/919810504039.

email._note: Runs before the domain rule so the address is replaced whole, not left as support@upitcollege.com's domain being rewritten twice. Covers mailto: links too, since they embed the same string.

address.from: D-70, 2nd FLOOR, MAIN PALAM DABRI ROAD, MAHAVIR ENCLAVE, NEW DELHI-110045
address._note: Also appears URL-encoded in the Footer's Google Maps link; the script re-encodes it. The schema.org block in app/(site)/layout.tsx stores the address split across separate fields in a different format and is updated by hand, not by this rule.
